title: Vientiane International Marathon 2026 Review: Laos's Capital Full Marathon at Saphangmo
seo_title: Vientiane International Marathon 2026 Review | Laos Race Guide
meta_description: The Vientiane International Marathon 2026: December 6 at Saphangmo, Vientiane, Laos. Full marathon, half, 10K, and 5K in one of Southeast Asia's rarest race destinations.
dek: Set for 6 December 2026 at the Saphangmo venue in Vientiane, Laos, this international marathon offers four distances. Registration isn't open yet and details are thin, but a full marathon in Laos is a genuinely rare proposition worth tracking.
verdict: The Vientiane International Marathon offers one of the rarest race propositions in Southeast Asia: a full marathon in Laos, a country with fewer annual road races than most Thai provinces. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K) at the Saphangmo venue in the capital, and a December date that catches Laos's cool, dry season. The reliability score is low (20), registration isn't open, and the organiser hasn't been identified — so this is firmly in the 'watch, don't book' category. But for runners collecting country ticks, Laos is one of the region's hardest boxes to check.

sections.heading: Laos: The Rarest Country Tick
paragraphs: Laos has one of Southeast Asia's smallest running calendars — a handful of events in Vientiane and Luang Prabang. [1] A full marathon here is a genuinely rare opportunity for country-tick collectors. December in Vientiane is cool and dry, with morning temperatures in the mid-to-high teens — among the best running conditions in the region.
